component.name: BurstScene
component.script:
' 5 writes before the Task launches (delivered by the launch replay), then a burst of ' 20000 after it is running (delivered by render->task fan-out). Each must arrive once. sub init() m.sink = CreateObject("roSGNode", "BurstSink") for i = 1 to 5 m.sink.entry = { "l": i } end for m.timer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.2 m.timer.observeField("fire", "sendBurst") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub sendBurst() for i = 1 to 20000 m.sink.entry = { "l": i } end for m.sink.observeField("received", "onReceived") m.sink.save = true end sub
sub onReceived() print "received=" ; m.sink.received m.global.finished = true end sub
